text: Over the past three years, the Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) has been committed to restoring, refurbishing, and enhancing the condition of its facilities. Our State of Good Repair (SOGR) strategy is a structured, facility-by-facility approach designed to systematically assess, repair, restore, and refurbish each site before moving on to the next. This proactive strategy ensures long-term asset sustainability and enhances user experience. By comprehensively addressing each facility, Toronto Parking Authority ensures its assets remain safe, reliable, and aligned with evolving user expectations while also maximizing long-term value and operational efficiency. The purpose of this paper is to seek authorization from the Board of Directors, Toronto Parking Authority (TPA), for the garage restoration project located at 29 Holly Street (Car Park 29) valued at $4.5 million in base scope, plus…

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Provided authority to the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to award the Garage Restoration project located at 75 Holly Street (Car Park 29) for 2025-CON-CP29-B10 to Complete Concrete Restoration Limited, having submitted the lowest compliant bid and meeting all specifications in conformance with the Construction Tender requirements, in the amount of $4,495,030.00 in base scope, plus $341,700.00 in selected optional items, plus $1,450,000.00 as a contingency allowance, being the sum total of $6,286,730.00 excluding Harmonized Sales Tax (HST).
